design_description: A sleek black-and-gold jersey built around sharp, symmetrical geometric detailing. The black base stays clean through the upper body, while thin gold angular lines rise from the lower sides and converge toward the centre. The front features a structured central graphic combining fine vertical gold pinstripes with stacked downward chevrons, creating a technical, modern look. Gold trim on the collar and sleeve cuffs completes the two-colour palette. The back simplifies the same concept, with layered gold V-shaped lines concentrated toward the lower body and a large white number for strong contrast. Overall, it's clean, premium and highly structured, with restrained gold geometry rather than an all-over pattern.
